Page Content: aston martin Aston Martin Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences DESIGN TAKES THE LEAD Aston Martin partnered with DarGlobal on The Astera, a Ras Al Khaimah development that brings the marque's first residential project to the Gulf. This landmark collaboration marks Aston Martin's entry into branded living, translating decades of automotive craftsmanship into architecture. Two icons. Bound by a shared obsession with precision and craft. The result? Legendary performance, at home on one of the Gulf's most coveted coastlines. It's more than a residence, it's a legacy you can live in. It's power, poured into place. related projects Ras Al Khaimah | UAE The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin Al Marjan Island | RAK Top of the Astera Ras Al Khaimah | UAE The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin Al Marjan Island | RAK Top of the Astera Articles And News Jul 14, 2025 DarGlobal Awards Main Works Contract for ‘The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin’ to Gulf Asia Contracting LLC DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, proudly announces that Gulf Asia Contracting LLC (GAC), a renowned General Contractor in the GCC with extensive industry experience and ongoing operations in the region, has been awarded the main works contract for its prestigious 'The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin' project. Apr 25, 2024 DarGlobal announces partnership with Aston Martin to deliver stunning beachfront residences in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates DarGlobal, the London listed luxury international real estate developer, has announced a new partnership with Aston Martin. The collaboration will see the British ultra-luxury marque carefully craft interiors for an exquisite beachfront residential development in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates. Oct 15, 2024 Dar Global Kicks Off Construction at The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin, with the Appointment of Stromek Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, proudly announces that Stromek Emirates Foundations, a leading engineering and construction firm renowned for delivering high-quality foundational work across the region, has been awarded the contract for shoring, excavation, and piling works for its prestigious 'The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin' project. Jun 05, 2024 Dar Global Introduces Stunning Beach Residence The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer today unveils ‘The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin’¸ an exquisite new beachfront residential development bringing Aston Martin’s renown for ultra-luxury interior design to the highly desirable Al Marjan islands in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates. Frequently Asked Questions - The Astera by Aston Martin Who developed The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin? The Astera is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Aston Martin, marking the British marque's first real estate collaboration in the GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council). Where is The Astera located? The Astera sits on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, near the Wynn Resort with direct beachfront access, about an hour's drive from Dubai. What types of residences are available at The Astera? The development offers one, two and three-bedroom apartments alongside three-bedroom villas, each finished with Aston Martin's signature interior design. Is this Aston Martin's first real estate project in the Middle East? Yes. The Astera marks Aston Martin's first real estate collaboration in the GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council), following earlier design partnerships in the United States and Japan. What is the value of The Astera development? The Astera carries a Gross Development Value of approximately AED 900 million, around £200 million. When is The Astera expected to be completed? Construction is underway following the appointment of Stromek Emirates Foundations for shoring, excavation and piling works, with completion due by December 2028. What amenities does The Astera offer? Residents have access to a private beach, an infinity pool with ocean views, a scenic walking track, an indoor cinema, a fitness centre, a spa, a yoga lawn, a children's play area and a multipurpose hall. What makes the Aston Martin interiors distinct? Aston Martin's design team applies the marque's signature blend of sophistication, precision craftsmanship and high-performance design language to every residence's interior. How far is The Astera from Dubai? Dubai is approximately an hour's drive from Al Marjan Island, keeping The Astera close to the city while offering a secluded beachfront setting. Can international buyers obtain UAE residency by purchasing at The Astera? Buyers investing AED 2 million or more qualify for the UAE's 10-year Golden Visa, and the UAE applies 0% income tax and 0% property tax. Show more Live All In Discover it with us. Frequently Asked Questions - Da Vinci by Pagani Who developed Da Vinci Tower? Da Vinci Tower is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Pagani Automobili and is the world's first Pagani-branded residential development. Where is Da Vinci Tower located? Da Vinci Tower is located in Downtown Dubai, directly on the Dubai Canal, with views of the Burj Khalifa and moments from Marasi Business Bay. What types of residences are available at Da Vinci Tower? The tower offers 2, 3 and 4-bedroom residences ranging from 77 to 398 sq m, each with private outdoor areas and panoramic views of the canal and Downtown Dubai. Is Da Vinci Tower really the first Pagani residential project? Yes. Da Vinci Tower is the world's first residential development with interiors by Pagani, applying the brand's design philosophy to luxury living. What do the Pagani-designed interiors include? Interiors crafted by Pagani feature premium leather, Italian marble, kinetic chandeliers, carbon fibre accents and lush wood panelling. What amenities does Da Vinci Tower offer? Amenities include a rooftop pool overlooking Downtown Dubai, a state-of-the-art gym, sauna and steam rooms, 24/7 concierge, and private access to the residences through discreet elevators. How tall is Da Vinci Tower? The tower rises 19 floors above the Dubai Canal, with three basement levels and a grand ground floor. How far is Da Vinci Tower from key Dubai landmarks? The Dubai Mall and Fountains are about 9 minutes away, and Dubai Marina is around 20 minutes away. Can international buyers obtain UAE residency by purchasing here? Buyers investing AED 2 million or more qualify for the UAE 10-year Golden Visa, and Dubai applies 0% income tax and 0% property tax. What makes Da Vinci Tower unique? From its favorable tax environment and its strategic location as a gateway to the Middle East and Africa, Oman offers countless opportunities for businesses to grow and thrive. 01 Life-time Residency Visa for ITC project investors 02 Upcoming UAE-Muscat railway project 03 100% Freehold Ownership for all nationalities* 04 0% Personal Income tax 05 0% Capital Gains tax 06 0% Inheritance tax (inheritance laws of owner's country apply) 07 25 years exemption from corporate income taxes in special economic/free zones 08 Stable and Growing Economy with low inflation 09 One of the safest countries in the world 10 Ideal Location with easy access to the Gulf, Indian subcontinent, and Africa 11 Tourism Hub with projected earnings of $22.5bn by 2040 12 Cosmopolitan community with over 100 nationalities 13 The Quality of Life Index by Numbeo ranked Oman 7th globally and 1st in both Asia and the Arab world in 2023. 14 Saudi-Oman Highway: Cuts travel by 16 hours, driving tourism and investment. 15 Exclusive mortgage program in Oman for resident and non-resident buyers, designed to enhance real estate returns. Frequently Asked Questions What are Trump Cliff Villas at AIDA? Trump Cliff Villas are a collection of fully furnished three-bedroom sea-view villas at AIDA, Muscat, developed by DarGlobal. Each villa is positioned directly beside the Trump International Hotel at 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera, with a private pool overlooking the sea. Villas are designed and furnished to the highest standard, with every detail specified down to specification. What are the villa sizes and unit types available? Trump Cliff Villas offer three-bedroom furnished residences from 128 to 166 sqm. Each villa includes a private pool with sea views. Owners receive a Trump International Golf Club Social Membership as part of the purchase and have the option to reside in or lease the villa. What does the Trump Cliff Villas offer that other AIDA products do not? Trump Cliff Villas offer full villa ownership with a private pool, the closest positioning to the Trump International Hotel, and the most elevated sea views on the AIDA estate. Unlike Trump Golf Villas, which face the golf course, These villas are positioned on the cliff edge with direct sea orientation. Both villa products sit within the same AIDA estate and share access to the same championship golf course and community facilities. What amenities are available to Trump Cliff Villa owners? Within the AIDA estate, villa owners have access to the Trump International Golf Club Oman (18-hole championship course), Trump Members Only Club, The SHFT Night Club, 5-star dining and culinary facilities, AIDA Beach, Trump Hotels Hanging Suites, a Trump International Hotel lobby, community and retail centres, plazas, cafes and restaurants, wellness centres, fitness centre, promenades, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, viewing decks, and outdoor landscapes across the cliffside estate. When will Trump Cliff Villas be completed? Completion is scheduled for December 2028. Construction is underway and live progress feeds are available on the DarGlobal project page. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to book a unit, choose your residence via the online navigator, or download the project brochure. Can I lease my Trump Cliff Villa when I am not using it? Yes. The entry data states that owners have the choice to reside in or lease their villa. The Trump management association with the property supports the leasing proposition. Contact DarGlobal for further details on the leasing model and revenue arrangements. Can foreign nationals buy Trump Cliff Villas in Oman? Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. ITC project buyers are eligible for a lifetime residency visa in Oman. An exclusive mortgage program is available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers. Buyers should confirm specific eligibility conditions with DarGlobal or their legal advisor. What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman real estate? Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes. Why invest in Muscat property now? Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in both Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries in the world. Tourism earnings are projected to exceed $22.5 billion per year by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time between the two countries by 16 hours, and an upcoming UAE-Muscat railway project will further strengthen connectivity and investment activity. How do Trump Cliff Villas relate to the wider AIDA development? Trump Cliff Villas are one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal products at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman (hotel room ownership), Trump Golf Villas (five-bedroom fairway villas), Marriott Residences Aida, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a fully integrated branded resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera. Every unit has sea or Burj Khalifa views. World's highest pool. Register your interest. Page Content: Download Brochure BOOK UNIT Gallery Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai Dubai | UAE PROPERTY TYPE Branded Hotel & Residential Tower UNIT TYPE 1, 2, 3 Bedroom Apartments & 4 Bedroom Duplex Penthouses STATUS Under Development AREA (SQFT) 764 - 7,720 FEATURING The highest pool in the world Challenge Everything. Stop At Nothing. Step inside. Look around. This is what winning looks like. Residences & penthouses with soaring ceilings and bespoke finishes. Every inch, a statement of dominance. Overlook the shimmering skyline, the grandeur of Burj Khalifa or the limitless sea. These are the headquarters for the ambitions of visionaries, disruptors, and game-changers. And you’re next. View All Images KEY FEATURES The Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai brings together three iconic worlds in one address: a five-star hotel, a members-only club, and private residences, each with its own state-of-the-art amenities. Trump International Hotel & Tower A five-star luxury hotel, joining the legacy of Trump organization most iconic hotels. Featuring fine dining, world-class entertainment, and true luxury at every turn. The Trump, Members-Only Club The Trump Members-Only Club brings together wellness, business, and the timeless atmosphere of a classic private club. Access is limited to members only through an annual fee, with residents receiving priority access. The Trump Residences Featuring 1, 2, & 3-bedroom apartments and 4-bedroom penthouses, the residences dominate the skyline — with every unit offering a view. Residents also enjoy exclusive access to the highest outdoor pool in the world. AMENITIES OF THE TRUMP RESIDENCES The following amenities are reserved exclusively for residents. Residents can also apply for membership to the Trump Members-Only Club to access its iconic spaces and experience the full lifestyle. Rooftop infinity pool, the highest in the world State of the art gym Owners lounge Kids play area Frequently Asked Questions What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai? Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai. What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai? The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa. When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed? The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability. Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located? The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown. Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool? Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities. What is the Trump Members-Only Club? The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool. What amenities are exclusive to residents of the Trump Residences? Residents have exclusive access to the world's highest rooftop infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, an owners lounge, and a children's play area. Membership to the Trump Members-Only Club is available separately for access to the wider lifestyle facilities within the building. Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment? The project sits in one of Dubai's highest-demand corridors, combining a globally recognised brand, a world-record amenity, and direct Downtown proximity. Branded residences in Dubai have historically commanded rental premiums over comparable unbranded units; buyers should seek independent advice on investment suitability. How does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai differ from other luxury towers in Dubai? It is the only development in the Middle East to combine a Trump five-star hotel, a residents-only world-record infinity pool, and a private members club under one address. The hotel-residential structure gives owners access to hotel-grade services alongside private ownership. How do I register interest or enquire about buying at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai? Prospective buyers can register interest, download the project brochure, or book a private viewing through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request. content: Website: DarGlobal Title: Elie Saab Residences Qatar | DarGlobal Branded Living URL: https://darglobal.co.uk/partners/elie-saab Description: Les Vagues by Elie Saab brings haute couture living to Qatar's Qetaifan Island North. Explore DarGlobal's first co-branded residences. Book a viewing. Page Content: elie saab ELIE SAAB Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences HIGH FASHION LIVING. ELEVATED. Elie Saab partnered with DarGlobal on Les Vagues, a Qetaifan Island North development that brings the couturier's eye for line and detail to Qatar's coastline. This landmark collaboration marks Elie Saab's first co-branded residences, translating haute couture into a permanent address. Two visionaries. One from the runway, one from the skyline. The result? Considered amenities, effortless convenience, and coastal elegance, gathered under one name. It's more than a home, it's a silhouette you live inside. It's fashion, made permanent. related projects Doha | Qatar Les Vagues by Elie Saab Doha | Qatar Les Vagues by Elie Saab Articles And News Mar 17, 2022 DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects unveil premium sea-front residences with interiors designed by ELIE SAAB in Qetaifan Island North – Qatar Les Vagues residences by ELIE SAAB were unveiled by DarGlobal, the leading real-estate company in Saudi Arabia, during an exclusive event held in Doha, Qatar in collaboration with Qetaifan Projects, a leading Qatari real estate development company fully owned by Katara Hospitality. Mar 23, 2022 DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects unveil premium sea-front residences with interiors designed by ELIE SAAB at Expo 2020 Dubai The Qatar Pavilion at Expo 2020 Dubai hosted the launch of Les Vagues residences by ELIE SAAB, a luxury residential project that’s being developed by DarGlobal, the leading real-estate company in Saudi Arabia, and Qetaifan Projects, a leading Qatari real estate development company fully owned by Katara Hospitality. Oct 23, 2022 DarGlobal launches sales of the most premium residential address in Qatar, Les Vagues by Elie Saab, with views of Lusail skyline and the sea at Qetaifan Island North The project is a partnership between Qetaifan Projects and DarGlobal in Doha Les Vagues are the first ever residences with interiors designed by ELIE SAAB in Qatar. Frequently Asked Questions - Elie Saab Who developed Les Vagues by ELIE SAAB? Les Vagues is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Qetaifan Projects and ELIE SAAB, marking the first co-branded residences on Qatar's Qetaifan Island North. Where is Les Vagues located? Les Vagues sits on Qetaifan Island North in Lusail, Qatar, with views of the sea, marina and Lusail skyline. What types of residences are available at Les Vagues? The development offers 70 one, two and three-bedroom sea-front residences with balconies, terraces and floor-to-ceiling windows. Is this ELIE SAAB's first residential project in Qatar? Yes, Les Vagues marks ELIE SAAB's first residences in Qatar, following an earlier DarGlobal collaboration with the designer in Riyadh. What is the value of Les Vagues? Les Vagues is valued at over 1 billion Qatari Riyal. What do the ELIE SAAB interiors include? Interiors reflect ELIE SAAB's refined elegance, with public areas furnished from the ELIE SAAB Maison Collection and exquisite craftsmanship throughout. What amenities does Les Vagues offer? Residents have access to à la carte concierge services, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, an infinity pool, a landscaped courtyard with sea views, a 24-hour reception desk, luxury retail outlets and parking. When did sales for Les Vagues launch? Sales officially launched in October 2022. What is Qetaifan Island North? Qetaifan Island North is a waterfront entertainment and lifestyle destination featuring a waterpark, a luxury hotel, retail and residential development. What makes Les Vagues unique? Les Vagues is the first co-branded residential project by ELIE SAAB on Qatar's exclusive Qetaifan Island North. Show more Live All In Discover it with us. Live All In Discover it with us. title: DarGlobal | Tokenization
content: Website: DarGlobal Title: DarGlobal | Tokenization URL: https://darglobal.co.uk/tokenization Description: Page Content: Tokenization: Investing in the Future, Today DarGlobal is evolving how the world invests in luxury real estate. Through blockchain-powered tokenization, we’re making access to high-value properties smarter, more flexible, and globally connected. What Does This Mean for You? We’re turning physical assets into digital tokens - fractional shares of our premium properties that investors can buy, sell, or hold. This opens the door to new opportunities: Simplified Access Invest in DarGlobal’s most exclusive projects from anywhere in the world. Liquidity with Confidence Trade your tokens through regulated platforms while knowing you’re backed by real-world assets. Azure Oceanfront Villas is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Fendi Casa, part of the AIDA master development in Oman. Where are the Azure Oceanfront Villas located? The villas sit within AIDA, DarGlobal's hilltop master development on the coast near Muscat, Oman. What is Fendi Casa? Fendi Casa is the home and interiors division of the Italian luxury house FENDI, founded in Rome in 1925. What does the FENDI name bring to these villas? FENDI brings a century of Italian craftsmanship and design innovation to residential interiors for the first time through this collaboration. Who has led FENDI's creative direction over the years? What is AIDA? AIDA is one of Oman's largest premium mixed-use developments, spanning 3.5 million square metres on a hilltop over 100 metres above sea level. AIDA's first phase is expected to complete in 2027. What other brands are part of AIDA? AIDA also includes Trump International Hotel, Trump Golf Villas, Trump Cliff Villas and Marriott Residences. Oct 23, 2024 Dar Global advances construction at Tierra Viva, its first European luxury development with Automobili Lamborghini Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has commenced infrastructure works for Tierra Viva, its first residential project in continental Europe in collaboration with Automobili Lamborghini. Frequently Asked Questions - Automobili Lamborghini Who developed Tierra Viva? Tierra Viva is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Automobili Lamborghini, marking the brand's first residential project in continental Europe. Where is Tierra Viva located? Tierra Viva is located in Benahavís, Spain, an 8-minute drive from Marbella on Spain's south coast. What types of residences are available at Tierra Viva? The community includes 53 grand villas across three designs: Diamante (6-bedroom), Zafiro (5-bedroom) and Esmeralda (4-bedroom). What is the value of Tierra Viva? Tierra Viva is valued at approximately €282 million. What security does Tierra Viva offer? The community sits within the gated development of Los Jararillos, with two gate houses and 24/7 premium security. How does the design reflect Lamborghini's influence? Villas feature polished marble floors, fine leather and glass elements, echoing Lamborghini's design DNA in both form and material. What amenities does each villa include? Each villa offers direct car access, a panoramic swimming pool, multiple terraces and flourishing gardens set at varied elevations for Mediterranean Sea views. How far is Tierra Viva from key landmarks? Residents have easy access to the beach, Marbella Club Golf Resort, Puerto Banús, Marbella Club Golden Mile and the Marbella Marina. What is the construction status of Tierra Viva? Infrastructure works are underway, with Sacyr Construction delivering the surrounding road, water and electricity networks. Tierra Viva is a limited collection of ultra-luxury gated villas in Benahavís, Spain, developed by DarGlobal with design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini. Villas are staggered across the hillside at different levels in the Los Jaralillos district to ensure every home captures unobstructed panoramas of the Mediterranean Sea. What is Automobili Lamborghini's involvement in Tierra Viva? Automobili Lamborghini provided the design inspiration for Tierra Viva, with the project integrating the brand's approach to cutting-edge design, technology, and artisanal craftsmanship into villa architecture and interiors. The collaboration between DarGlobal and Lamborghini positions Tierra Viva as a convergence of performance culture and ultra-luxury residential living. What villa sizes are available at Tierra Viva? Tierra Viva offers a limited collection of villas ranging from 700 to 1,450 sqm. The collection is available in different villa configurations, including select units with an in-villa car lift. Contact DarGlobal for current unit availability and full specification details. When will Tierra Viva be completed? Tierra Viva is under development with completion scheduled for June 2028. Construction is actively underway, with progress updates available on the DarGlobal website. Contact the sales team for current payment plan terms and unit availability. Where exactly is Tierra Viva located? Tierra Viva is in the hills of Los Jaralillos, Benahavís, 15 minutes from Marbella and within easy reach of Puerto Banús and Sotogrande. The location gives direct access to 12 nearby golf clubs, Andalusian villages, and the shores of the Mediterranean, while remaining in one of the most prestigious residential areas on the Costa Del Sol. What amenities does Tierra Viva offer? Tierra Viva is a gated community with 24/7 premium security, an exclusive residents' clubhouse, sauna, steam room, and private pool areas. Select Painite villas include an in-villa car lift. The community is designed around the concept of seclusion and belonging rather than shared hotel-style facilities. Can I obtain a Spain Golden Visa by purchasing at Tierra Viva? Spain's Golden Visa programme is available to non-EU buyers making qualifying real estate investments. Given villa sizes and values at Tierra Viva, buyers should confirm current programme thresholds and eligibility with a qualified legal adviser, as Spain's Golden Visa rules have been subject to legislative review. DarGlobal can assist with introductions to legal professionals. Why invest in Costa Del Sol real estate? Spain is consistently ranked as offering among the highest real estate ROI in Europe, with low Eurozone interest rates between 3 and 5%, open regulations for foreign investors, and a robust tourism sector that supports rental returns. Benahavís specifically is one of the wealthiest municipalities in Spain and benefits from year-round Mediterranean climate and high-speed train connections to the wider coast. What makes a Lamborghini-branded villa different from other luxury villas in Spain? Branded residences at this tier consistently command significant price premiums over comparable unbranded stock. Tierra Viva combines the scarcity of a limited villa collection in Benahavís, one of Europe's most sought-after addresses, with a globally recognised automotive design brand. That pairing targets a very specific international buyer pool, which supports both value retention and resale appetite. How do I register interest or buy a villa at Tierra Viva? content: Website: DarGlobal Title: Marriott Residences Oman | DarGlobal Branded Living URL: https://darglobal.co.uk/partners/marriott-residences-aida-oman Description: Marriott Residences at AIDA, Muscat combine five-star hospitality with private ownership. A DarGlobal collaboration in Oman. Register your interest. Page Content: Marriott International Residences Marriott Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences FIVE STARS. UNLIMITED RETURNS. Marriott partnered with DarGlobal on Marriott Residences, a Muscat, Oman development at AIDA that brings five-star hospitality into everyday living. This landmark collaboration marks Marriott's expertise in service paired with DarGlobal's real estate craft in one address. Two disciplines. Hospitality and home, meeting in the middle. The result? The seamless convenience of a world-class hotel, with the privacy of a residence you own. It's more than service, it's a lifestyle on call. It's five stars, permanently yours. related projects Muscat | Oman Marriott Residences Muscat | Oman Marriott Residences Frequently Asked Questions - Marriott International Residences Who developed the Marriott Residences at AIDA? The Marriott Residences are developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Marriott International, as part of the AIDA master development in Muscat, Oman. Where are the Marriott Residences located? The residences sit within AIDA, DarGlobal's hilltop master development around 10 minutes from Downtown Muscat, Oman. What is AIDA? AIDA is one of the largest premium mixed-use developments in Oman, spanning 3.5 million square metres on a hilltop over 100 metres above sea level. What does the Marriott partnership bring to these residences? Marriott International brings its refined hospitality service model to full-time residential living, pairing hotel-level convenience with private home ownership. Who else is developing AIDA alongside DarGlobal? AIDA is a joint venture between DarGlobal and Omran Group, the executive arm of the Sultanate of Oman for tourism development. What other brands feature within AIDA? AIDA also includes Trump International Hotel, Trump Golf Villas and Trump Cliff Villas, developed in partnership with The Trump Organization. Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad is a collection of luxury branded villas in northern Riyadh, developed by DarGlobal. Mouawad, the internationally renowned jewellery house, designed the interiors of each five-bedroom villa, bringing its signature approach to refined finishes, artisanal craftsmanship, and timeless elegance to a residential setting. What did Mouawad design at Neptune? Mouawad provided the full interior design across each Neptune villa, applying the brand's heritage in precision and luxury material quality to every room from the entry foyer and living spaces through to the master suite, bathrooms, and kitchen. The collaboration translates Mouawad's jewellery-house sensibility into an architectural and residential context. What villa sizes are available at Neptune? Neptune offers five-bedroom villas with built-up areas ranging from 300 to 420 sqm. Each villa includes a master bedroom with walk-in closet and en-suite, secondary bedrooms, a family kitchen, guest living area, and terrace with views of the surrounding landscape. When will Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad be completed? The project is under development with completion scheduled for December 2027. DarGlobal is the master developer. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms, or explore available villas via the online residence navigator. Where is Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad located? Neptune is in the northern district of Riyadh, positioned in close proximity to the Expo 2030 Riyadh site, placing residents at the centre of one of Saudi Arabia's most significant urban development corridors under Vision 2030. What community amenities surround Neptune? The Neptune community is supported by schools, a community centre, sports hub, restaurants and cafes, public parks, entertainment centres, early childhood centres, retail and grocery, playgrounds, mosques, and healthcare clinics within the wider neighbourhood. Is Riyadh real estate open to foreign investors? Yes. Full freehold ownership is now available to foreign investors in Saudi Arabia. Property investment of 4 million SAR or more qualifies buyers for residency eligibility. The Saudi Riyal is pegged to the US Dollar, providing currency stability, and Saudi Arabia applies 0% capital gains tax, 0% wealth tax, and 0% inheritance tax. Why invest in Riyadh property under Saudi Vision 2030? Riyadh is set to host the FIFA World Cup 2034, Expo 2030, Formula 1, and the Asian Games, driving unprecedented infrastructure investment. King Salman International Airport is scaling to 185 million passengers, and Riyadh Air is expanding global connectivity. Saudi Arabia is considered one of the safest countries globally and the safest in the G20. What makes Neptune a limited-edition collection? Neptune is positioned as a limited edition collection, meaning a restricted number of villas are available, each featuring bespoke Mouawad interiors and individual design attention that cannot be replicated at scale. The scarcity of a Mouawad-branded residential product in Riyadh places it in a distinct tier above standard luxury villa developments in the city. How do I register interest or buy a villa at Neptune? Buyers can register interest, explore available villas via the online residence navigator, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request. title: FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions | Darglobal
content: Website: DarGlobal Title: FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions | Darglobal URL: https://darglobal.co.uk/faq Description: Page Content: Frequently Asked Questions DarGlobal creates luxury properties and branded residences that blend lifestyle, design, and long-term value. Through global partnerships and meticulous craftsmanship, we deliver premium homes and communities built with integrity and purpose — offering investors a sense of belonging, measurable value, and a legacy that lasts. Why invest with DarGlobal? DarGlobal is built for a new kind of global investor - one who values not just ROI, but ROE and ROL. Who is DarGlobal? DarGlobal develops real estate that speaks for itself, where lifestyle and value come together. We work with trusted global partners to create homes, communities, and destinations that grow in meaning and worth over time. Our approach is simple: deliver with integrity, design with care, and build with purpose. For those who see the world as their home, DarGlobal offers not just investment, but belonging — value you can measure, and pride you can feel, and a legacy you can pass forward. What's ROI, ROE and ROL? ROI (Return on Investment) : measurable financial growth and lasting capital appreciation. ROE (Return on Ego) : the pride, identity, and social value of owning something that reflects who you are and what you stand for. ROL (Return on Legacy) : the confidence that what you build today will stand for something tomorrow. We see the world as one connected home — where value is something you live, not just measure. Our community of investors, partners, and visionaries builds with purpose and pride. With DarGlobal, every investment becomes a lasting mark of trust, identity, and inheritance for the future. What makes DarGlobal different? We work with clarity, purpose, and collaboration — turning global partnerships into lasting opportunity. Guided by over three decades of experience, every development reflects trusted execution and measurable value. Where does DarGlobal operate? Across 14 cities in 9 countries, including Spain, London, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, the UK, and the Maldives. What types of properties do you offer? We develop residences, cities, and hospitality projects in the world’s most dynamic destinations. Each one is designed as both a home to live in and an investment to grow. Why partner with global brands? They deliver something rare — ROE (Return on Ego): the pride of owning what few can, and the distinction of belonging to a world defined by rarity, scarcity, and status. Each collaboration is designed to create an asset of identity and desire. Can international buyers invest? Yes. DarGlobal is built for the global citizen — our destinations welcome international investors with full ownership rights, residency privileges, and secure, transparent investment frameworks. How does the buying process work? Select your property, consult our advisors, reserve securely, and complete your purchase digitally or through our global offices. Investing with DarGlobal Experience smart global investing with DarGlobal — from Dubai to London, discover curated opportunities in world-class developments. How can I invest in DarGlobal properties? Investing with DarGlobal is designed to be seamless and global. Choose a project, speak with our advisors, and secure your unit digitally or through any of our international offices. Whether you live in Dubai, Riyadh, Jeddah, Muscat, Doha, London, Marbella, or New York — your investment journey begins wherever you are. What are the benefits of investing in off-plan luxury properties? Off-plan at DarGlobal means entering early into high-growth destinations, benefiting from attractive prices, flexible payment plans, and the appreciation that comes with world-class design and brand collaborations. It’s not just smart investing — it’s securing future value today. Are DarGlobal projects suitable for international investors? Absolutely. DarGlobal is built for global citizens. Our destinations offer secure frameworks, full ownership rights, residency benefits, and a transparent buying process — making international investment simple, strategic, and protected. What kind of returns can I expect? Each development is strategically positioned for capital appreciation and strong rental yields. From premium Dubai residences to branded Marbella villas and waterfront Muscat properties, returns grow as the cities grow — delivering ROI, ROE, and ROL. Is my investment with DarGlobal secure and transparent? Yes. With over three decades of delivery, DarGlobal is anchored in trust, clarity, and transparent processes. Every investor is protected by local regulations, escrow systems, and our global partnerships — ensuring peace of mind at every step. Our Luxury Properties & Projects Discover what makes our luxury properties and iconic collaborations truly exceptional worldwide. What types of properties does DarGlobal offer? From branded villas and penthouses to resort-style residences and city apartments — every DarGlobal property is crafted for lifestyle, investment, and legacy. These are homes designed to live beautifully and invest confidently. Where are DarGlobal properties located? Across the world’s most desirable destinations: Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Muscat, Doha, Riyadh, Jeddah, Costa del Sol (Spain), the Maldives, London, and more — each chosen for growth, desirability, and global appeal. What are co-branded residences? These are homes crafted in collaboration with the world’s most iconic luxury brands — from fashion to hospitality to design — offering elevated architecture, exclusive services, and long-term value driven by global brand equity. Which upcoming projects are open for investment? Multiple developments across the UAE, Oman, KSA, Spain, London, and the Maldives are currently open, including high-demand branded districts and resort-led communities. Your advisor can guide you to the opportunities best aligned with your investment goals. Do DarGlobal properties come fully furnished or customizable? Many of our branded residences are offered fully furnished with world-class interior design. Select projects also offer customization options, allowing buyers to tailor their home to their lifestyle and aesthetic. Collaborations & Brand Partnerships Where luxury craftsmanship meets global identity. Which global brands has DarGlobal collaborated with? DarGlobal partners with iconic names across fashion, hospitality, and design — delivering residences that carry global distinction and rarity. What makes co-branded residences unique? They offer something few can own: ROE — Return on Ego. Craftsmanship, scarcity, elevated lifestyle, and brand legacy come together to create homes that are not just lived in — they are admired. How do partnerships enhance property value? Brand equity drives desirability, rental performance, resale value, and long-term appreciation. A branded residence is not just a property — it’s a global asset backed by decades of reputation. Which upcoming collaborations or branded projects are launching soon? DarGlobal continues to expand through new partnerships across the GCC, Europe, and Asia. Speak with our advisors to register for upcoming launches and exclusive early access. How can I invest in a co-branded DarGlobal residence? Choose your preferred development and reserve your unit through our global sales team. International and remote investors can complete the entire process digitally with full transparency. Buying Process & Ownership Discover a seamless buying experience tailored for HNWI and global investors. What is the process to buy a DarGlobal property? 1. Choose your property 2. Review the investment plan with our advisors 3. Reserve your unit securely 4. Sign digitally or through our offices worldwide 5. Complete payment and registration with full support from our team Can international buyers purchase DarGlobal properties? Yes — our global structure is designed for international ownership, offering straightforward procedures and access to attractive residency pathways where applicable. What payment plans are available? Each development offers flexible installment plans, making global investing accessible while maximizing capital efficiency. How does property registration work? Registration is completed with the respective land department or governing authority in each country. DarGlobal provides full guidance to ensure a smooth and compliant process. What documents or approvals are required to complete a property purchase? Typically: 1. Passport copy 2. Contact information 3. Reservation form 4. Payment details Certain markets may require additional documentation, and our advisors guide you step-by-step. About DarGlobal Crafting timeless luxury across continents — designed for living, legacy, and investment. Who is DarGlobal? DarGlobal creates real estate that speaks for itself — where design, integrity, and purpose come together. We collaborate with trusted global partners to build destinations that gain meaning and value over time. For the world citizen, we offer not just investment — but belonging. How long has DarGlobal been in luxury real estate? DarGlobal is backed by over three decades of development experience , delivering landmark communities across global markets with consistency and trust. What makes DarGlobal different? We deliver more than properties — we deliver results: 1. Wealth protected across cycles 2. Lifestyle defined by beauty and craftsmanship 3. Legacy that lives forward And we build with clarity, trust, and global partnerships that elevate every development. Where is DarGlobal headquartered and which markets do they operate in? DarGlobal is headquartered in London and operates across 14 cities in 9 countries , including Spain, the UK, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, and the Maldives. Is DarGlobal a publicly listed company, and where is it traded? Yes, DarGlobal is publicly listed, offering investors the added confidence of regulated transparency and corporate governance. Page Content: mouawad Mouawad Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences BUILT FOR BRILLIANCE Mouawad partnered with DarGlobal on Neptune Villas, a North Riyadh development that brings the jewelry house's mastery of rare materials into residential design. This landmark collaboration marks Mouawad's first foray into real estate, translating gemcraft into architecture. Two connoisseurs. One cuts stone, one shapes cities. The result? Gemlike homes set within a lifestyle-rich setting of schools, parks, and dining. It's more than a villa, it's a rare find made to live in. It's brilliance, built to last. related projects Riyadh | Saudi Arabia Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad Riyadh | Saudi Arabia Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad Articles And News Sep 23, 2024 Let it Rain Diamonds: Dar Global and Mouawad High Jewellery House Unveil SAR 880 Million Landmark Residential Project Dar Global, the London-Stock Exchange listed international real estate company, has entered into a landmark partnership with Mouawad, the luxury jeweler, to launch a unique SAR 880 million (GBP 180 million) residential project close to World Expo 2030 in the North of Riyadh. The high-profile collaboration represents Dar Global’s debut in the Saudi market, a significant milestone in the company’s international expansion strategy. The project also marks Mouawad’s planned move into the luxury residential sector, where it will apply its reputation as a leader in refined craftsmanship to expand its operations into new frontiers. Neptune is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Mouawad, marking the jewellery house's first move into luxury residential real estate. Where is Neptune located? Neptune is located within SEDRA, North Riyadh's master-planned community, close to the World Expo 2030 site. What is the value of the Neptune development? Neptune is valued at SAR 880 million, approximately GBP 180 million. How many villas does Neptune include? The development comprises 200 residential villas. When is Neptune expected to be handed over? The development is currently underway, with completion and handover targeted for late 2027. What does the Mouawad design bring to Neptune? Mouawad applies over 130 years of jewellery craftsmanship and refined detailing to Neptune's residential interiors. Can international buyers obtain Saudi residency by purchasing at Neptune? Yes, owners of properties valued at SAR 4 million or more qualify for Real Estate Owner Residency under the Saudi Premium Residency program. What surrounds the Neptune development? Neptune sits within a lifestyle-rich setting with schools, parks, dining, wellness facilities and retail nearby. Is this Mouawad's first real estate partnership? Yes, Neptune marks Mouawad's first entry into branded residential real estate after more than a century as a jewellery house. What makes Neptune unique? Neptune pairs Mouawad's century-old craftsmanship legacy with DarGlobal's debut development in the Saudi market. Show more Live All In Discover it with us. Live All In Discover it with us. Page Content: Blogs Nov 13, 2026 Top Features High-Net-Worth Buyers Look For The definition of prestige in real estate has undergone a fundamental transformation. While opulent finishes and prime addresses remain prerequisites, today's HNWI (High-Net-Worth Individual) buyer views a residence as an extension of their personal values, wellness philosophy, and security requirements. Nov 06, 2026 Future of Branded Residences The global real estate landscape is undergoing a monumental shift, with the market for high-end branded developments expanding at unprecedented speeds. Crossing beyond traditional hotel-operated apartments, the next generation of property projects blends hospitality, architectural prestige, and lifestyle curation to redefine the concept of luxury living. Oct 30, 2026 How to Evaluate a Luxury Property Before You Invest Investing in high-end real estate offers substantial wealth preservation, capital appreciation, and strong market status. However, the luxury market operates under very different rules than traditional residential housing. Standard valuation formulas often fall short because premium properties trade on emotional value, architectural distinction, and geographic exclusivity rather than strictly square footage. Oct 16, 2026 Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate When building a high-value real estate portfolio, evaluating the trade-offs between capital growth and rental yield stands as one of the most critical steps in strategy development. Both metrics serve distinct roles in wealth generation, but in the luxury segment, they behave differently than in mass-market residential property. Oct 09, 2026 Luxury Waterfront Properties: What Makes Them So Valuable? Few asset classes hold the prestige, financial resilience, and emotional appeal of a waterfront luxury property. Whether situated along iconic coastlines, serene lakeshores, or private island enclaves, prime waterfront real estate consistently commands the highest valuations in global real estate. Oct 05, 2026 The Complete Guide to Investing in Dubai Off-Plan Properties Investing in real estate has consistently proven to be a cornerstone of global wealth creation, and few markets capture the imagination of international investors quite like Dubai. Sep 25, 2026 What Makes a Luxury Real Estate Developer Worth Investing With? Investing in prime property requires evaluating the entity building the asset just as rigorously as the geographic location itself. In the upper echelons of residential real estate, a developer’s execution capability, strategic vision, and brand equity directly influence total returns. Sep 18, 2026 How Luxury Real Estate Supports Global Mobility and Residency For high-net-worth individuals, physical property is no longer merely a domestic store of wealth or a passive asset class. In an increasingly interconnected economic landscape, prime residential real estate serves as an anchor for international freedom, sovereign risk management, and borderless lifestyle planning. Sep 11, 2026 Why Luxury Real Estate Should Be Part of Every Investment Portfolio High-net-worth investors and family offices constantly refine their capital allocation strategies to protect wealth while driving sustainable growth. While equities, fixed income, and venture capital remain traditional staples, adding physical prime property introduces unique structural stability. Examining the foundational drivers of luxury property ROI demonstrates how strategic acquisitions secure lasting wealth across market cycles. Aug 31, 2026 Luxury Real Estate Trends That Will Shape 2026 The high-end residential housing market is entering an era defined by intentionality, technological discretion, and health-focused architecture. Modern high-net-worth buyers are re-evaluating what true luxury means, shifting away from ostentatious displays of size toward functional elegance, sustainability, and personal well-being. Understanding the dominant luxury real estate trends is essential for investors, developers, and homeowners looking to build long-term value in a dynamic market. Aug 21, 2026 Is Buying a Second Home Still a Smart Investment? The real estate landscape has evolved rapidly over the past few years. Driven by shifting workplace norms, evolving interest rate environments, and changing lifestyle priorities, buyers are looking at real estate with a fresh perspective. One central question consistently emerges for high-net-worth individuals and capital allocators: Is buying a second home still a smart investment? Aug 14, 2026 Best Countries for Luxury Real Estate Investment in 2026 The global prime property market is undergoing a structural transformation. Driven by evolving financial policies, strategic wealth preservation initiatives, and dynamic economic shifts, high-net-worth individuals are continually evaluating where to allocate long-term capital. Identifying the best countries to invest in real estate requires a balanced framework that goes far beyond aesthetic appeal. Smart cross-border investors prioritize high capital appreciation potential, robust rental yields, direct tax optimization, structural liquidity, and long-term residency advantages. Aug 10, 2026 How International Investors Buy Luxury Property with Confidence The global distribution of private capital has changed the way premium real estate is acquired. Today, high-net-worth individuals do not limit their portfolios to their home countries. Instead, they actively seek institutional stability, lifestyle flexibility, and high capital growth across multiple borders. Jul 17, 2026 Why Dubai Remains the World's Leading Luxury Property Market The global ultra-luxury property sector is experiencing a period of significant recalibration. While traditional wealth capitals navigate regulatory changes, tax adjustments, and slowing growth, one market consistently defies global trends. Dubai has firmly established itself not merely as a regional safe haven, but as the absolute capital of the global elite. Jul 13, 2026 Why Branded Residences Continue to Outperform Traditional Luxury Homes The global ultra-luxury housing market is undergoing a structural evolution. After 13:00, the airport manager (more like a caretaker) would lock the doors at 13:15 and take the keys with him. Today, Dubai moves more than 90M passengers a year, Abu Dhabi around 30M, and Doha over 50M - and extraordinary leap in one generation. A DarGlobal collaboration steps from iconic landmarks. Book a viewing. Page Content: w hotels W Hotels Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences STAY ADVENTUROUS W Hotels partnered with DarGlobal on W Residences, a Dubai Downtown development that brings the brand's bold, urban-edged design language into residential living. This landmark collaboration marks W's vision for redefining modern luxury carried into a permanent address. Two spirits. Both restless, both urban. The result? Contemporary amenities designed for how you actually live, steps from the city's icons. It's more than a residence, it's a stage for the city. It's luxury, wide awake. related projects Dubai | United Arab Emirates W Residences Dubai | United Arab Emirates W Residences Articles And News Feb 20, 2023 DarGlobal awards the main works of W Residences in downtown Dubai for AED273,000,000 AED DarGlobal, the luxury real estate developer, is set to begin main works on the highly anticipated W Residences and has awarded the W-Residences project construction to China State Construction Engineering Corporation -Middle East (CSCEC ME). Feb 25, 2022 DarGlobal reveals W Residences Dubai – Downtown overlooking Dubai’s Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, has unveiled the W Residences Dubai – Downtown in the bustling heart of Dubai, offering hotel-inspired living at one of the most sought-after addresses in the world. The 1 billion AED development is anticipated to mark the first standalone residences in the world under the iconic lifestyle W Hotels brand. Frequently Asked Questions - W Residences Who developed W Residences Dubai – Downtown? W Residences Dubai – Downtown is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with W Hotels, with residence management by Marriott International. Where is W Residences Dubai – Downtown located? The residences sit in Downtown Dubai, with views of Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Fountain, Dubai Opera and Old Town Dubai. How many residences does the tower include? The tower comprises 384 exclusive residences. What is the value of W Residences Dubai – Downtown? The development was valued at AED 1 billion at launch, with main construction works later awarded for AED 273 million. When is W Residences Dubai – Downtown expected to complete? Completion was originally estimated for September 2026. Please verify with the sales team for the final building handover and move-in schedule. Is this the first standalone W-branded residential project in the world? Yes, W Residences Dubai – Downtown marks the first standalone residences globally under the W Hotels brand, developed by DarGlobal . What amenities does W Residences offer? Residents have access to the FUEL wellness concept, an infinity pool overlooking Burj Khalifa, the FIT Fitness Centre, a spa, a media room with cinema, a coworking space and a clubhouse. What is the Whatever/Whenever service? Whatever/Whenever is W Hotels' signature concierge service, offering round-the-clock in-residence dining, housekeeping, laundry and lifestyle assistance. How far is W Residences from key Dubai landmarks? The residences are about 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 10 minutes from DIFC, and minutes from The Dubai Mall. Are units still available at W Residences Dubai – Downtown? The development has previously been reported as sold out; buyers interested in resale opportunities should check current availability with DarGlobal directly. Aida, Oman The Great Escape 2 AIDA, Muscat, Oman Sunrise Haven View All Projects Frequently Asked Questions What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman? Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Marriott name under license from Marriott International. Residences come with à la carte hotel-style services and are designed to deliver the comfort and standard associated with the Marriott brand. Who developed Marriott Residences Aida, Oman? The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which operates the Marriott brand name under a licensing agreement with Marriott International, Inc. Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed, or sold by Marriott International or its affiliates. What unit types and sizes are available? The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces. What services do residents receive at Marriott Residences? Residents benefit from à la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. The service model is designed to bring hotel-quality living to private residential ownership at the AIDA estate. What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners? The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay. When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed? Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure. Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman? Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers on ITC-registered projects are eligible for a lifetime residency visa. An exclusive mortgage program is also available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers. What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman? Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes. Why invest in Muscat real estate now? Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries worldwide. The country targets over $22.5 billion per year from tourism by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time by 16 hours between the two countries, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat will further strengthen regional connectivity and investment appeal. How does Marriott Residences relate to the wider AIDA development? Marriott Residences is one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal projects at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman, Trump Golf Villas, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a multi-branded, fully integrated resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera. Les Vagues by Elie Saab is a branded seafront residential complex on Qetaifan Island North, Doha, developed by DarGlobal. Elie Saab provided the interior design for each residence and the building's common areas, bringing the Lebanese fashion house's signature aesthetic of cream, marble, bronze, and premium stone to one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments. What did Elie Saab design at Les Vagues? Elie Saab was responsible for the full interior design of each residence, as well as the building's lounges and lobby areas, personally selecting all furniture for the common spaces. The design palette centres on cream and grey tones, shiny metal finishes, bronze, marble, and premium stone, reflecting the couture-level craftsmanship the house is known for. What unit types and sizes are available at Les Vagues? Les Vagues offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences ranging from 86 to 389 sqm on Qetaifan Island North. The development is 30 minutes from Hamad International Airport, within minutes of Qatar's largest theme park, and sits alongside 7 km of beach shoreline, a vibrant marina, and a signature 18-hole golf course and clubhouse. What amenities does Les Vagues offer within the building? Building amenities include an infinity swimming pool, state-of-the-art fitness centre, four personal elevators per unit including a service elevator, 24-hour reception, luxury retail, covered parking for all units, and a landscaped community courtyard with sea views. Lobby and lounge furniture was designed and personally selected by Elie Saab. What lifestyle facilities does Qetaifan Island North offer? Qetaifan Island North delivers 7 km of beach shoreline, private beaches, a marina, world-class boating facilities, boutique shopping, a water park, a winter garden, a signature 18-hole golf course and clubhouse, and 5-star hotels and amenities, functioning as a fully self-contained luxury destination in Doha. Qatar hosted the FIFA World Cup 2022 and processes approximately 40 million tourists annually through Hamad International Airport, consistently rated the world's best. Location Frequently Asked Questions - AIDA Find answers about AIDA by DarGlobal in Muscat, Oman, including property ownership, branded residences, lifestyle amenities, and investment potential. What is AIDA by DarGlobal and what makes this development unique? AIDA is a fully master-planned destination in Muscat, Oman, designed as a city within a city. Developed by DarGlobal, it combines luxury residences, branded hotels, golf courses, nature, and lifestyle amenities in one integrated community. Where is AIDA located in Oman? AIDA is in Muscat, Oman, about 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport, elevated 130 meters above sea level along the coastline, offering scenic views. Can international buyers own property at AIDA? Yes. AIDA offers 100% foreign ownership within designated investment zones, ideal for investors and second-home buyers. How can I register my interest or book a viewing at AIDA? You can register your interest through our website or by visiting one of our offices . If you are outside Oman, the sales team will contact you and arrange the most suitable way to connect. If you are in Oman or planning a visit, you can visit the office and enjoy a private, one on one site tour, including a visit to the development, the views, and the latest construction updates. What types of properties are available at AIDA? AIDA offers apartments, luxury villas, hotel residences, and branded or non-branded residences. Explore your options for investment or lifestyle living. Are there branded residences at AIDA? Yes. AIDA features branded residences in collaboration with internationally recognized brands, including Trump and Marriott. Does property ownership include golf access? Golf access is available through membership at Trump International Golf Club Oman, subject to application and approval. Who is developing AIDA in Oman? AIDA is a master plan developed by DarGlobal in partnership with OMRAN, collaborating with global brands such as the Trump Organization and Marriott . What makes AIDA a city within a city? AIDA offers residential living, hospitality, leisure, wellness, retail, and outdoor experiences all in one destination, allowing residents to live, relax, and socialize without leaving the community. Is AIDA a gated community in Muscat, Oman? Yes. AIDA is a private, gated community in Muscat offering controlled access, security, and a secure residential environment designed for privacy and peace of mind. Who is AIDA designed for? AIDA is designed for end users, second-home owners, and international investors seeking a luxury resort lifestyle, long-term value, and globally benchmarked living standards in Oman. How accessible is AIDA from the region? AIDA is accessible with a 60-minute flight from Dubai and has strong connections to regional and international destinations. What views are available from properties at AIDA? Homes at AIDA offer sea views, golf course views, or valley/wadi views. The master plan integrates natural landscapes with parks and elevated viewpoints. How is nature integrated into the master plan? AIDA features landscaped parks, hiking and cycling trails, and outdoor adventure zones, blending luxury living with Oman’s natural environment. Is there a golf course at AIDA? Yes, there is an 18-hole trump championship golf course. What is the AIDA Residence Club? The AIDA Residence Club offers wellness, leisure, dining, and community facilities exclusively for residents. Is AIDA suitable for families? Yes. AIDA is designed for families, with amenities and spaces suited for all age groups. Does owning property at AIDA provide residency benefits? Eligible property ownership gives access to lifetime residency in Oman, subject to regulations. Are financing and payment plans available at AIDA? Buyers can access mortgage solutions and structured payment plans, typically linked to construction milestones. Can I rent out my property at AIDA? Yes. Approved properties can be rented on a short-term basis, with professional management services available. What amenities are available at AIDA? Amenities include swimming pools, parks, wellness and fitness centers, restaurants, kids’ play areas, outdoor cinemas, and adventure zones. Are properties at AIDA managed? Yes. Selected residences and hotel units are fully managed, including Trump International Hotel and Trump Cliff Villas, for hassle-free ownership. Is rental management available at AIDA? Yes. Owners can opt for rental management services to generate income from eligible units. What are the key residences at AIDA? AIDA includes Trump Golf Villas , Trump Cliff Villas , Fairway Villas , The Great Escape , Marriott Residences and more , each offering unique designs, views, and lifestyle benefits. Catering to global citizens seeking prime investments, second homes, and luxury living, DarGlobal transforms real estate into economic catalysts, unlocking opportunities for both investors and the countries it enters. DarGlobal has partnered with over 11 world-renowned luxury brands, including Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance. Page Content: Missoni Missoni Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences A COLLABORATION OF A DIFFERENT STRIPE Missoni partnered with DarGlobal on two residential concepts, Urban Oasis in Dubai and Marea on Spain's Costa del Sol. This landmark collaboration marks Missoni's first venture into branded real estate, carrying the house's signature color and craft into interior design. Two capitals. One thread running through both. The result? Curated amenities and scenic views, dressed in the house's unmistakable palette. It's more than an interior, it's a wardrobe for a home. It's Italian style, laid in every room. related projects Dubai | United Arab Emirates Urban Oasis By Missoni Cortesin | Spain Marea, Interiors by Missoni Dubai | United Arab Emirates Urban Oasis By Missoni Cortesin | Spain Marea, Interiors by Missoni Articles And News Sep 15, 2024 Missoni and Dar Global launch residential development project in southern Spain Missoni and Dar Global, an international real estate development company, have announced the launch of “Marea, interiors by Missoni”, an exclusive residential development project near the Finca Cortesin hotel and golf club, a short walk from the center of Marbella and from the marinas of Puerto Banuìs and Sotogrande, in southern Spain. Dec 06, 2021 DarGlobal teams with Missoni to deliver the exclusive Urban Oasis water-front residential tower in Dubai DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, has unveiled the Urban Oasis residential tower in Dubai in partnership with the luxury Italian fashion house, Missoni, known for its bold colours and iconic zigzag motifs, stripes, and wave patterns. Apr 12, 2022 DarGlobal tops out its Urban Oasis by Missoni residential tower in Dubai at 34 stories DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, is celebrating the significant milestone of topping out its Urban Oasis residential tower in partnership with the luxury Italian fashion house, Missoni, at 34 stories. The structural completion milestone was celebrated by the company’s Chairman, Yousef Al Shelash, as he visited site and participated in the topping out ceremony. Frequently Asked Questions - Missoni What Missoni-branded projects has DarGlobal developed? DarGlobal has partnered with Missoni on two projects: Urban Oasis in Dubai and Marea in Cortesin, Spain. Where is Urban Oasis located? Urban Oasis sits on the Dubai Water Canal in the heart of Dubai, close to Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall. Where is Marea located? Marea is located near the Finca Cortesin hotel and golf club on Spain's Costa del Sol, close to Marbella, Puerto Banús and Sotogrande. What types of residences does Urban Oasis offer? Urban Oasis spans 38 floors with one, two and three-bedroom apartments plus four-bedroom penthouses accessible via private elevator. What types of residences does Marea offer? Marea offers two, three and four-bedroom apartments within an 18,500 square metre complex. What is the value of Urban Oasis? Urban Oasis is valued at AED 800 million. What amenities does Urban Oasis offer? Residents have access to a swimming pool, a children's play area, car parking, a gymnasium and 24/7 concierge and security services. What amenities does Marea offer? Marea offers premium security, a state-of-the-art gym, an infinity pool, a tennis court and children's play areas. Who designed the interiors? Urban Oasis was furnished by Missoni's MissoniHome line; Marea's interiors were curated by Alberto Caliri, Missoni home collection creative director, under Rosita Missoni's supervision. Is this Missoni's first real estate collaboration? Urban Oasis marked the Arab world's first bespoke Missoni-inspired living spaces; Marea followed as Missoni's second residential partnership with DarGlobal. Show more Live All In Discover it with us.
